main_text.p: omnium peccatorū corpora resuscites, & tuo conglorificato reddas cōformia. His dictis, Saluatori nostro suam animā commendauit: & paulo post pie & tranquillè in Domino obdormiuit. Sicut ergo hic pijsimus princeps hanc sapientiam diuinam, non iuxta sapientum huius seculi iudicia cōtempsit: sed & in tota uita, & in agone mortis summum gaudium ipsi fuit, doctrinam Euangelij audire & promouere: sic has optimi Principis uirtutes filius eius illustrissim' Princeps Georgius Fridericus Marchio Brandenburgensis, &c. diligeter imitatur, in eo quod non solum Euangeliū suis subditis introductū à patre, per fideles Ecclesiæ doctores doceri permittit: uerùm etiam huic beneficio alia plura beneficia hactenus addere nō dubitauit. Quia ad priora stipendia à patre suo pientissimo Principe pauperibus scholasticis ordinata, noua quædā adiecit: scholamq; in quodam cœnobio instituì curat utiliter, in quam ex singulis suis præfecturis, certis temporibus quosdam suorū subditorum filios introducere, & bonis litteris atq; sumptibus necessariis procurare

page.notes: Left margin strip is cut off and largely illegible; only fragments such as "Regna", "Brandenb." are visible and were not transcribed. Word "scholamq;" and "litteris" partly obscured by a smudge at line end; "litte" read with [?] in mind but the final letters are damaged.
